desc: Reveal finer details at long distances with the powerful Steiner Predator 15x56 binoculars. Built with military-grade toughness and durability, these 15x binoculars feature Predator diamond coating, a proprietary Steiner technology, providing superior light transmission and high-definition images. Overbuilt to handle the toughest environments, these rugged binoculars deliver exceptional clarity and detail at long distances and in low-light conditions, where every second counts. Designed for hunters who want more from their gear, the Predator 15x56mm binoculars help you see more while carrying less.
